company.name: Inflammatix
company.shortDescription: Inflammatix develops rapid immune system diagnostics to improve patient care and public health.
company.description:
Inflammatix develops novel molecular diagnostics for acute infections and sepsis that work by 'reading' the immune system.  It is a molecular diagnostics company developing rapid tests that read the immune system to resolve major clinical and public health challenges.

They are initially focused on developing tests for acute bacterial and viral infections, and sepsis based on patent-pending biomarkers exclusively licensed from Stanford University.

productsAndServices.description: A blood test system that analyzes immune response mRNA to diagnose bacterial or viral infection and assess illness severity in suspected acute infection or sepsis patients within about 30 minutes.
productsAndServices.name: TriVerity™ Acute Infection and Sepsis Test System

productsAndServices.description: A fingerstick blood test designed to distinguish bacterial from viral infections in outpatient settings to guide antibiotic prescribing decisions.
productsAndServices.name: ViraBac EZ™ Acute Infection Test

productsAndServices.description: A research program that classifies sepsis patients into molecular subtypes (endotypes) based on transcriptomic profiles to guide therapy selection and improve treatment outcomes.
productsAndServices.name: Endotypes Program for Sepsis Subtyping

productsAndServices.description: An in vitro diagnostic that uses host mRNA expression to assess likelihood of bacterial or viral infection and illness severity in adult ED patients.
productsAndServices.name: TriVerity Test System

aiResearchSummary.text: Inflammatix is researching systems and methods for deriving and optimizing classifiers from multiple modules to evaluate clinical conditions, including assessing bacterial or viral status of a sample and diagnosis of respiratory viral infections. It develops a fluidic device and fluidic methods for processing biological samples and characterizing infection, isothermal amplification based diagnosis and treatment of acute infection, and gene expression based diagnostics for myocardial infarction and inflammatory bowel disease, covering infection, inflammation, and cardiac events.
